title: Portfolio for a design studio
request: I run a two-person design studio. Make me a portfolio page: who we are, six selected projects with images, the services we sell, and a contact form.
rubric: Does the page present work first and talk about the studio second, the way a portfolio does, with six projects actually present?
why: A portfolio names a count ("six") and a medium (images). It catches planners that ignore quantities and planners that reach for a text block when a media grid was asked for.
